common.tagline: Decide with structure. You own the judgment.

home.title: AHP Studio
home.subtitle: Analytic Hierarchy Process for humans — AI assembles data, you commit judgment.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use OAuth for production accounts, or Dev Login for local MVP without OAuth secrets.
login.noProviders: No auth providers configured. Set AUTH_DEV_LOGIN=true or OAuth client secrets in .env.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.subtitle: What are we deciding today?
decisions.empty: No decisions yet. Create one to start modeling criteria and judgments.
decisions.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Which phone should I buy?

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.subtitle: Build the hierarchy. Components appear as you add data.
criteria.empty: Add at least one criterion to begin.
criteria.name: Name
criteria.needMore: Add another criterion to unlock pairwise importance.

pairwise.title: Importance comparisons
pairwise.subtitle: Compare criteria on the Saaty 1–9 scale. You commit; agents only propose.
pairwise.locked: Pairwise comparisons appear when there are at least two criteria.
pairwise.howMuchMore: How much more important is the left criterion?
pairwise.proposalsPending: {count, plural, one {# proposal awaiting your commit} other {# proposals awaiting your commit}}

snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.subtitle: Freeze model state so you can rewind during modeling.
snapshots.label: Label
snapshots.promptPlaceholder: What you asked (or note for yourself)…
snapshots.summaryPlaceholder: Short summary of agent or human changes…

connect.title: Connect an agent
connect.subtitle: Optional: API keys for Cursor MCP. The primary agent is the in-app ChatKit chat.
connect.name: Key name
connect.createdOnce: Copy this key now — it will not be shown again.
connect.instructionsBody: Add a server entry like docs/mcp-cursor.example.json, replace the Bearer token with your key, and restart Cursor MCP.

chatkit.title: AHP agent
chatkit.subtitle: Prompt to assemble criteria — you own the judgments.
chatkit.bootstrapError: Could not start ChatKit session. Sign in and try again.
chatkit.promptCompareText: Help me compare two products: gather criteria and alternatives, propose importance judgments for me to review.
chatkit.promptCriteriaText: Suggest a solid criteria hierarchy for my current decision and add them as agent-sourced criteria.
chatkit.promptJudgmentsText: Propose Saaty pairwise importance for my criteria (as proposals only). Do not commit.
